files.rationale: Kept PR A's --stream/--signal-url test as res5 and renumbered PR B's --interval and --stream-encode tests to res6/res7 so all three new checks run without name collisions.

Kept PR A's tsc-compiled CommonJS output (no-audio flag, withAudio, encode progress, WebCodecs fallback) and wove in PR B's interval/stream-encode options, variables, timed-capture and streamEncode wasm argument, plus the tar-stream/ffmpeg-static check, so the JS matches the merged TypeScript source.

Combined PR A's typed CLIValues, no-audio/withAudio logic and WebCodecs fallback with PR B's interval and stream-encode options (added to CLIValues too), streamEncode passed to startWasmRecording, timed-capture startup and the tar-stream/ffmpeg-static dependency check.
